raw.title: Game theory
raw.extract: Game theory is the field of applied mathematics that models strategic interactions between rational agents as "games" between "players". It is a scientific method of describing, predicting, evaluating, and selecting choices, often with the view of maximizing utility outcomes for one or more players.
